get.description: Lists parcels using cursor pagination. Default page size is 20.

notes: Pagination now uses page numbers instead of opaque cursors. Existing cursor values are ignored. Clients must migrate before upgrading.
policy: Existing clients must continue to work without code changes. Preserve pagination, defaults, units, auth, rate limits and error semantics. Additive optional request fields and additive response fields are allowed. Removing documented fields or operations is breaking.
